summary.short: Italian decree-law of 15 September 2023 (Caivano), in force 16 September 2023, on youth distress, educational poverty and juvenile crime. Fetched text covers Articles 1–10-sexies: a commissioner and EUR 30 million plan for Caivano, funding and hiring measures. Digital-minors provisions (Chapter IV) are not in the fetched text.
summary.long: Decree-law on urgent measures against youth distress, educational poverty and juvenile crime, and on minors' safety in the digital environment. The fetched text (Articles 1–10-sexies) provides for a Commissioner appointed by decree of the Prime Minister within fifteen days of entry into force to prepare and implement an extraordinary infrastructure plan for the municipality of Caivano. The plan is approved by Council of Ministers resolution, with resources up to EUR 30 million from the Fondo per lo sviluppo e la coesione, and implementation may depart from non-criminal laws, subject to anti-mafia rules, general legal principles and EU constraints. The Commissioner's term runs to 31 December 2027 (Art. 3). Further articles cover works at the former Delphinia sports centre, university-funded educational projects, at least EUR 100,000 for video surveillance in Caivano for 2024, and authorised hiring of 15 municipal police officers, 3 social-service staff and 6 school educators, with budget coverage. Article 10-sexies assigns the Minister for the family a promotion role for anti-violence services in Caivano. The fetched text contains no penalties, enforcement provisions or AI-specific provisions. The digital-minors provisions of Chapter IV are not included in it.
